analyst.summary: Affle is a mobile advertising and consumer-intelligence technology platform with a debt-free balance sheet and a genuinely consistent multi-year growth track record (around 19-20% annually, verified quarter by quarter). The company continues to expand through bolt-on acquisitions (most recently AdColony) and international expansion. The stock is not cheap, and receivables have lengthened somewhat, but the underlying growth story looks real rather than engineered. We rate it a Hold.
